# Hologram

Turns a mesh into a projected hologram: see-through additive light with moving scanlines, a bright fresnel rim, a gentle flicker and occasional glitch slices. Flicker stays slow and shallow, and flicker, glitches and scrolling stop when motion is off.

<EffectDemo effect="hologram" />

## Usage

```ts
import { patchMaterial } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { hologram } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/hologram';

const effect = hologram({ preset: 'projection' });
patchMaterial(mesh.material, effect);
const clock = new THREE.Clock();
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => {
  effect.tick(clock.getDelta());
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
});
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.color = '#5ad8ff'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter          | Type                                                      | Default     | Range    | Description                                                                          |
| ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `color`            | hex color (theme: [`accent`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles)) | `'#5ad8ff'` |          | Hologram color.                                                                      |
| `intensity`        | number                                                    | `1.2`       | 0 – 5    | Brightness, in linear units.                                                         |
| `shading`          | number                                                    | `0.5`       | 0 – 1    | How much of the original lighting shows through.                                     |
| `rimPower`         | number                                                    | `2.5`       | 0.5 – 8  | Width of the bright rim: higher hugs the silhouette.                                 |
| `rimIntensity`     | number                                                    | `2`         | 0 – 8    | Brightness of the rim.                                                               |
| `scanlineDensity`  | number                                                    | `40`        | 0 – 200  | Scanlines per world unit of height; 0 turns them off.                                |
| `scanlineStrength` | number                                                    | `0.5`       | 0 – 1    | Darkness between scanlines.                                                          |
| `scanlineSpeed`    | number                                                    | `0.3`       | -3 – 3   | Scroll speed of the scanlines, in world units per second.                            |
| `flicker`          | number                                                    | `0.12`      | 0 – 0.25 | Brightness wobble; slow (under 3 Hz) and at most 25%, to stay photosensitivity-safe. |
| `glitch`           | number                                                    | `0.06`      | 0 – 0.5  | Sideways shift of occasional horizontal slices, in object units.                     |
| `seed`             | integer                                                   | `0`         | 0 – 9999 | Picks the random pattern: the same seed always renders the same frames.              |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset       | Settings                                                               |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `projection` | `color: '#5ad8ff'`, `intensity: 1.4`                                   |
| `emerald`    | `color: '#3ddc97'`, `scanlineDensity: 60`, `rimIntensity: 3`           |
| `damaged`    | `flicker: 0.25`, `glitch: 0.2`, `scanlineStrength: 0.7`                |
| `steady`     | `flicker: 0`, `glitch: 0`, `scanlineSpeed: 0`, `scanlineStrength: 0.3` |

Apply one with `hologram({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Holographic & iridescent · tracked as story X11.3 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Kind:** material effect. `patchMaterial(material, effect)` splices it into MeshBasic, Lambert, Phong, Standard, Physical, Toon and Matcap materials, so lighting, fog and shadows keep working; `unpatchMaterial` removes it. See [material effects](/guide/materials).
- **Material settings:** while patched in, the material is set to transparent, additive blending, no depth writes, both faces drawn; they are restored when it is removed.
- **Motion:** Settles: when motion is off it switches to still values (`flicker: 0`, `glitch: 0`, `scanlineSpeed: 0`) without changing your settings.
- **Size:** 8.4 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/hologram`, including the shared effect runtime.
